_comment: One philosophy, multiple isolated systems. Boundaries are enforced, not hoped for. Layers are defined by the top-level import names that belong to them; a forbidden edge means code in 'from' must never import code in 'to'.

forbidden.why: no quantum on a real-time, safety-critical control path (non-deterministic; measurement destroys state)
production capability core stays classical + PQC; quantum is T3 research only
the autonomy gate is deterministic; quantum stays in the research sandbox
the control plane must not depend on the observability plane (dependency is one-way)
decisions never depend on analytics — FDK observes, it never controls
the safety path must not depend on analytics
the theory layer is pure: it must import no implementation
